_note: Scripted Risk flags for own-red-lines-01. Each Red line is named by its wording (redLineWords), and the local fake adapter turns that into the id it finds next to the wording in the prompt. Two matches are scripted below Don't sign as written on purpose: Review must raise both. The late-delivery deduction matches no Red line and keeps its Severity. The last flag names an own Red line but quotes a sentence the document does not contain, so it must be withheld like any flag.

riskFlags.title: Ninety days to pay
riskFlags.says: Kaveri Retail pays each invoice within ninety days of receiving it.
sourceSentences: Buyer will pay each invoice within ninety days of receiving it.
riskFlags.redLineWords: A customer taking more than 30 days to pay an invoice
riskFlags.counterOffer: Buyer will pay each invoice within thirty days of receiving it.

riskFlags.title: No printing for other grocery retailers
riskFlags.says: Tara Print and Pack cannot print packaging for any other grocery retailer during the agreement or for two years after it ends.
sourceSentences: Supplier will not print packaging for any other grocery retailer during the term of this Agreement.
This restriction continues for two years after this Agreement ends.
riskFlags.redLineWords: Any ban on printing for other customers
riskFlags.counterOffer: Supplier will not print packaging for any other grocery retailer during the term of this Agreement. This restriction ends when this Agreement ends.

riskFlags.title: Designs and plates belong to the buyer
riskFlags.says: Every design, artwork file and printing plate Tara Print and Pack makes belongs to Kaveri Retail as soon as it is made.
sourceSentences: Every design, artwork file and printing plate Supplier makes under this Agreement belongs to Buyer from the moment it is made.
riskFlags.redLineWords: The customer owning our designs or printing plates
riskFlags.counterOffer: Every design, artwork file and printing plate Supplier makes under this Agreement belongs to Supplier.

riskFlags.title: Disputes only in Bengaluru
riskFlags.says: Only the courts at Bengaluru can decide a dispute under the agreement.
sourceSentences: Any dispute under this Agreement will be decided only by the courts at Bengaluru.
riskFlags.counterOffer: Any dispute under this Agreement will be decided only by the courts at Pune.

riskFlags.title: Deduction for late delivery
riskFlags.says: Kaveri Retail can deduct 2% of the order value for each day an order is late.
riskFlags.judgment: No limit on the total deduction appears in the document.
sourceSentences: If Supplier delivers an order late, Buyer can deduct 2% of the order value for each day of delay.
riskFlags.counterOffer: If Supplier delivers an order late, Buyer can deduct 2% of the order value for each day of delay, and the total deduction will not exceed 2% of the order value.
